scheme_name: Cash Incentive to Wards of ESM (Academic Scholarship)
description:
The Cash Incentive to Wards of Ex-Servicemen (ESM) Academic Scholarship is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India.

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2017.

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the children of ex-servicemen pursuing education.

The scheme aims to encourage higher education among the wards of ESM.

It specifically targets students from economically weaker sections of society.

The scholarship is intended for students in various educational streams including professional courses.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is structured to support students at different levels of education.

For students in Class 11 and Class 12, the scholarship amount is ₹10,000 per annum.

For students pursuing undergraduate courses, the scholarship amount is ₹15,000 per annum.

For students enrolled in postgraduate courses, the scholarship amount is ₹20,000 per annum.

The scheme also includes provisions for students pursuing technical and professional courses.

The maximum scholarship amount for technical and professional courses is ₹25,000 per annum.

The eligibility criteria for this scholarship are clearly defined.

Applicants must be wards of ex-servicemen who have served in the armed forces.

The age limit for applicants is generally set at 25 years.

The income limit for the family of applicants must not exceed ₹6 lakh per annum.

Applicants must have secured admission in recognized educational institutions.

The scheme is applicable to students in both government and private institutions.

The application process for the scholarship is straightforward.

Interested candidates must fill out the application form available on the official website.

The application form requires details such as personal information and educational qualifications.

Applicants must also submit proof of their parent's service in the armed forces.

A copy of the admission letter from the educational institution is required.

Income certificate from a competent authority must also be submitted.

The application must be submitted online through the designated portal.

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set at the beginning of each academic year.

Applications are usually accepted from April to June.

Once the applications are submitted, they undergo a verification process.

The verification is conducted by the respective district welfare offices.

Disbursement of the scholarship amount is made directly to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

The scholarship amount is disbursed in one installment for the entire academic year.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare.

This department operates under the Ministry of Defence.

Contact details for the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare are available on their official website.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to support the welfare of ex-servicemen and their families.

The government recognizes the sacrifices made by armed forces personnel.

This scholarship is a step towards ensuring that their children have access to quality education.

The scheme has been well-received and has seen a significant number of beneficiaries since its inception.

In the financial year 2021-2022, approximately 25,000 students benefited from this scholarship.

The total amount disbursed under the scheme during that year was around ₹40 crore.

The scheme has contributed to reducing the financial burden on families of ex-servicemen.

It has also helped in promoting educational aspirations among the wards of ESM.

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach.

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements.

The scholarship is a vital tool in empowering the next generation of ex-servicemen's families.

It aims to bridge the gap in educational opportunities for these students.

The scheme aligns with the government's vision of inclusive education.

It also complements other welfare schemes aimed at supporting the armed forces community.

The Cash Incentive to Wards of ESM Academic Scholarship is a commendable initiative.

It reflects the government's commitment to the welfare of ex-servicemen and their families.

The scheme is an example of targeted financial assistance in the education sector.

It plays a crucial role in enhancing the educational landscape for underprivileged sections.

The scholarship is a lifeline for many families striving for better educational outcomes.

The application process is designed to be user-friendly and accessible.

This ensures that eligible students can easily apply for the scholarship.

The scheme is an important part of the government's efforts to honor the contributions of ex-servicemen.

It is a recognition of their service and sacrifices for the nation.

The scholarship not only provides financial support but also instills confidence in students.

It encourages them to pursue their academic goals without financial constraints.

The Cash Incentive to Wards of ESM Academic Scholarship is a significant step towards educational equity.

It empowers students to dream big and achieve their aspirations.

The government continues to promote such initiatives to foster a culture of education among ex-servicemen's families.

Overall, this scheme represents a meaningful investment in the future of the wards of ex-servicemen.
